website_summary.name: Biography Explorer Hub
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and organized layout featuring biographies of notable historical figures with interactive search capabilities and detailed profiles.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a minimalist design with a light background and dark text for high contrast. At the top, there's a prominent header titled "Extraordinary Lives," followed by a subtitle inviting users to explore remarkable individuals' biographies. Below the header is a search bar enabling users to look up profiles by name, profession, or keywords. The main content area displays a grid of biography cards, each containing a portrait image, the individual's name, profession, a brief description, and a "View Details" button. The cards are styled with subtle gradients and shadows, enhancing visual appeal. The overall aesthetic is professional and user-friendly, designed for easy navigation and readability.
website_summary.functionality:
The website includes several key functionalities:
- A search bar allows users to input queries and find specific biographies efficiently.
- Biography cards provide quick access to basic information about each individual, including their name, profession, and a short summary.
- Clicking the "View Details" button on a card leads to a more comprehensive page with in-depth information about the person's life, achievements, and honors.
- The layout supports responsive design, ensuring usability across various devices and screen sizes.

functionality_testing.name: Clicking "View Details" Button on Marie Curie Card Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the "View Details" button within the Marie Curie Biography Card navigates to the detailed profile.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Homepage loaded with biography cards visible, and the "View Details" button revealed after hovering.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Navigating to the detailed biography page upon clicking the "View Details" button. 7. Next Steps : Click the "View Details" button within the Marie Curie biography card to navigate to the detailed profile.
procedure: Click the "View Details" button within the Marie Curie Biography Card.
Verify navigation to the detailed biography page.

functionality_testing.name: Search Input Functionality Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the search input functions as expected.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The search input should be unfocused.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The search bar should filter the biographies according to the entered keyword, displaying the relevant cards.
procedure: Click on the Search Input to activate it.
Type a keyword related to a biography present on the page.
Press enter or click the search icon (if present).
Observe the results and ensure they match the search query.

functionality_testing.name: Verify View Details Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the 'View Details' button on Leonardo da Vinci's biography card navigates to the detailed view page.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Leonardo da Vinci Biography Card : Card containing Leonardo da Vinci's image, title, and a 'View Details' button
functionality_testing.preconditions: The web application is open, and the Leonardo da Vinci biography card is visible.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Upon clicking the 'View Details' button, the user should be redirected to a detailed page about Leonardo da Vinci.
procedure: Navigate to the main content area where biography cards are displayed.
Locate and click the 'View Details' button on Leonardo da Vinci's biography card.

data_display_testing.name: Martin Luther King Jr. Card Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the displayed information on Martin Luther King Jr.'s biography card matches the expected details accurately.

design_validation_testing.name: UI Design and Style Test: Color Palette
design_validation_testing.objective: To verify that the background color is set to snow and all elements are aligned correctly.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The background should be snow-colored, and all elements should be aligned correctly. 7. Next Steps : The next step is to validate the background color using developer tools.
procedure: Observe the background color and compare it to the snow color.
Check the alignment of the cards and search bar.
Ensure all elements are properly aligned and visually balanced.
